title: Mind the Gesture: Evaluating AI Sensitivity to Culturally Offensive Non-Verbal Gestures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image (T2I), large language models (LLMs), and vision-language models (VLMs) using the MC-SIGNS dataset by prompting them with explicit gesture-country pairs and implicit US-based conceptual descriptions to measure their ability to identify culturally offensive gestures, and comparing their detection accuracy across US and non-US contexts to identify US-centric biases.
